# Relaunch kickoff

Half-day workshop to start the website relaunch, facilitated by Maria Lopez. We agreed the scope for the first release: homepage, product pages and the help centre. The blog migrates later. Every workstream has one named owner and one backup.

Open questions for the agency: who approves the visual identity, how are redirects tested, and what is the freeze date for the legacy content. The next checkpoint is the design review in three weeks.

Part of [[Website relaunch]]; the roles are drawn in the [[Stakeholder map]].
